instruction_ref: BU-002 Sellemy CEO direct instruction 2026-11-19: 「恒久的に企画が狙い通りになるための修正方針」→「それで改修を。」
instruction: Preserve Planning reader purchase goal and distinct article search intent through Product selection, editorial plan, Writer and independent Article QA. Refuse repetitive generic same-theme search intents against live article job topics. Ensure each product selection reason carries verified product-specific detail, not only a group label. Independent Editorial QA evaluates all six product descriptions plus the entire article for generic repetition, changed purpose, unclear recommendations. No changes to numerical thresholds, search/retry quotas, role distribution, publication gates, new article admission, or existing saved job states.
implementer: sellemy-ops through isolated Mac Studio staging, direct non-Codex edits
preserved_rules: No generic lexical blacklist, fixed writing template, numeric editorial score, or new mandatory title format
Planner takes a product theme and sets reader goal; Writer independently sets final title
3 discovery axes x up to 10 candidates; article retains exactly 3x2 products
Missing nonessential evidence remains UNKNOWN and does not alone fail Planning QA
Reviewer quality receipt remains independent, hash/version bound; prior acceptance is not retroactively rewritten
No new runtime, queue, table, provider fallback, job status, or change to failure retry limits
No reopening old published articles or starting new production
CEO SHA-fixed staging review required before main production changes
